_comment: Single source of truth for the Experiments grid. Both index.html and experiments/index.html render from this. `showOnTopLevel: true` includes the entry on the top-level home page; the experiments/ subpage shows everything. `href` and topic hrefs are relative to the SITE ROOT — each consumer applies its own basePrefix (top page: '', subpage: '../').

experiments.title: DeepScan Voxel Explorer
experiments.description: GPU raymarched 3D/4D subsurface density tomography. Toggle between a synthetic voxel field and a Bingham Canyon site-informed model with real Sentinel-2 imagery and OSM pit boundaries.

experiments.title: Spatial GenAI Games
experiments.description: WebXR multi-game arcade — Connect-N variants, Cornhole, Model Railroad, NBA stream viewer, and a tabletop putt lab. Built on Meta's Immersive Web SDK with custom ECS systems and 3D button zones.

experiments.title: WebXR Experiments
experiments.description: Stereo rendering, A-Frame integration, custom GLSL shaders, and VR mode via the WebXR Device API.

experiments.title: Lumina Spatial Gallery
experiments.description: High-fidelity spatial media renderer for immersive 3D photography. Featuring depth-estimation, glassmorphic UI, and WebXR integration.

experiments.title: Spatial AI Case Studies
experiments.description: Interactive analysis of the leading spatial intelligence platforms — from Large World Models to neuromorphic vision and precision SLAM.

experiments.title: Slang Playground
experiments.description: Interactive shader editor powered by the Slang shading language compiler. Write, compile, and run shaders in the browser.

experiments.title: WebGL Shader
experiments.description: Animated raymarched blob rendered entirely in a GLSL fragment shader — no library, raw WebGL.

experiments.title: Artemis II Lunar Flyby
experiments.description: High-fidelity imagery from NASA's Artemis II mission. Experience the lunar surface and Earthset in stunning resolution.

experiments.title: Browser Geo Tests
experiments.description: Browser API test suite for location-aware outdoor experiences — GPS accuracy, tile maps, compass, proximity zones, and motion sensing.

experiments.title: AR Cube Placer
experiments.description: Place 3D cubes in augmented reality using your camera. Supports Hiro marker tracking with camera-forward fallback.

experiments.title: Laser Experiments
experiments.description: Tools for laser cutting and engraving: image vectorization, contour tracing, and AI prompt testing.

experiments.title: Video Neural Super Scaling
experiments.description: WebGPU-based neural rendering and spatial/temporal super-resolution on high-bitrate stereo video streams.

experiments.title: Mermaid Diagrams in Git
experiments.description: Interactive Mermaid.js gallery with live editing and image/code copying for Git-based documentation.

experiments.title: Marp Presentations in Git
experiments.description: High-fidelity Markdown presentations with custom styling, auto-scaling, and PDF/HTML export capabilities.
